'''[[Ziel of the Wasteland]]''' — ''introduced in [[Ghostwater (novel)|Ghostwater]]''

{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Ziel of the [[Wasteland]] is a horned boy from the [[Wasteland]] who departed [[Ghostwater]] and is known to wait on the sidelines for an advantage. Under the protection of the [[Beast King]], this man possesses emerald horns and a long, white beard. His body is ravaged by a toxic, venomous green energy, yet he remains an expert in revising [[Foundation]] theory. He utilizes a hammer, employing an [[Enforcer technique]] to manage its weight.
